Layout: code

Full-width code

RobotContainer.java

private void configureBindings() {

  // Sticks read negative when pushed away, and +rotation is counter-clockwise.

  drive.setDefaultCommand(

      drive.driveArcade(

          () -> -MathUtil.applyDeadband(driver.getLeftY(), DEADBAND) * DRIVE_SCALE,

          () -> -MathUtil.applyDeadband(driver.getRightX(), DEADBAND) * TURN_SCALE));

}

Part 3

Recurring layouts

Deck 0 · Template gallery

14

Common mistake

The robot spins in circles

What you see

Push forward and the robot turns on the spot.

Why it happens

Both sides run the same direction, but the motors face opposite ways.

The fix

Invert one side in its config: .inverted(true).

Deck 0 · Template gallery

15

Best practice

Keep numbers in Constants

Every CAN ID, limit and gain gets a name in Constants.java.

When a motor is swapped at competition you change one line, and the code explains itself.
